Final Event Report
Attendance:
・Total participants: 1,075
・In-person: 489
・Online livestreaming: 586

Geographical Diversity:
・Participants from 58 different countries

Nationality Breakdown:
・Japanese nationals: 48.3%
・Foreign nationals: 51.7%

Analysis:
・The summit successfully attracted a diverse international audience, with slightly over half of the participants being foreign nationals.
・The hybrid format (in-person and online) allowed for greater accessibility, with more participants joining online than in person.
・The event's global reach is evident from the participation of individuals from 58 different countries.

Feedback Analysis:
The feedback from the Tech for Impact Summit was predominantly positive, with attendees praising several aspects of the event. However, there were also areas identified for improvement. Here's a detailed breakdown:
Positive Aspects:
・Outstanding Speaker Lineup: Attendees consistently highlighted the quality and diversity of speakers, noting their expertise and engaging presentations.
・Diverse and Engaged Audience: The global representation and active participation of attendees were frequently mentioned as strengths of the summit.
